primer.method: Illustrative decomposition of measured raw: second-order Butterworth high-pass 0.05 Hz, scipy filtfilt default padding over full frozen 60-s E01 at 128 Hz; tonic = raw - phasic. Not physiological ground truth.

spectra.scope: median of 43 full-record Welch spectra; raw, clean, RP37 gate; 60 s segments; not excerpt spectra

transform: Peak filter: scipy butter(2,0.05/64,highpass), filtfilt default padding on full 60-s excerpt; find_peaks prominence .01 µS and distance 128. Cross: unmatched candidate after frozen metrics.py chronological greedy nearest-available one-to-one matching within ±128 samples. Display retains min/max in every 12-sample block, all marked peaks, endpoints. Primer: measured E01, tonic = raw - filtered phasic, illustrative only. PSD is archived median by frequency, no recomputation. MAE is physical µS; plotted pairs from A2 CSV; 0.1010 and 0.0830 are means of per-record artifact MAE, not medians.
